Copy only the requested fields; a full keymap dump is unnecessary.

### Physical layout

Attach a clear top-down photo of the keyboard or a full keyboard screenshot
from NuPhyIO. Show all keys and any knob or extra controls. Note any optional
modules or keycap changes that affect the reference.

<!-- Drag images into this text field when creating the issue. -->

### What needs changing?

Describe the missing layout or incorrect key positions, widths, or assignment
labels. For a label problem, include the selected mode and FN layer, the physical
key, what the widget shows, and what you expected. If known, include the matrix
row, column, or index for affected keys.
